title: CIA killed Ahmad Shah Massoud before 9/11; US created al-Qaeda to fight the Soviets

tellings.quote: Ahmed Shaw Masoud leading the northern alliance was a decent guy and the CIA killed him right before 911.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that Ahmad Shah Massoud, the Afghan commander who led the Northern Alliance against the Taliban, was a decent man and that the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, killed him just before the attacks of September 11, 2001. He also says the United States created al-Qaeda, the militant group behind those attacks, to fight the Soviet Union in Afghanistan from 1979 on, a claim that would put US spy agencies at the root of the events.
